summary: OKYO Pharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its participation in the Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference on November 10–12, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. CEO Robert J. Dempsey is scheduled to present at 9:20 a.m. ET on Thursday, November 12, 2026, with management available for one-on-one investor meetings. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The release notes the Phase 3 NEPTUNE trial of urcosimod for neuropathic corneal pain has enrolled its first patients; this is a routine investor-relations and conference notice, not a special situation.
